answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to compare the summaries generated by the Transformer and our TP-TRANSFORMER. We randomly sample 120 examples from the test sets... The table shows wins on Grammar, Coherency, Faithfulness, Saliency, Repetition, Overall.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare system outputs across multiple criteria (e.g., Grammar, Coherency, Faithfulness, Saliency, Repetition, Overall) and vote for the better summary.
